accessibility_contract.keyboard_access: home.resizer.terminal_section is reachable and activatable by keyboard when visible.
accessibility_contract.focus_management: home.resizer.terminal_section restores or transfers focus according to the owner contract after applied, no-change, failed, or cancelled disposition.
accessibility_contract.disabled_announcement: home.resizer.terminal_section announces state.home_workspace.home_resizer_terminal_section.disabled_reason and dispatches zero commands when unavailable.

test_evidence.requirement: Execute the visible control and assert exact command delta, payload, event/receipt set, disabled behavior, focus, and identity continuity.
The visible home.resizer.terminal_section control dispatches cmd.workspace_layout.resize_surface exactly once with the typed payload and production handler recorded by this row.
The browser harness reads the projected availability and disabled reason for home.resizer.terminal_section before attempting dispatch.
The browser harness asserts the exact receipt/event delta for home.resizer.terminal_section: workspace.layout_changed.
The rendered home.resizer.terminal_section control is keyboard reachable, exposes its accessible name/state, and preserves or restores focus according to the Home owner contract.

event_test_requirements: Assert cmd.workspace_layout.resize_surface preserves command_id, correlation_id, expected revision when applicable, and idempotency semantics.
Assert exact effects for home.resizer.terminal_section: workspace.layout_changed; no unexpected event.
